TOR.name: Tornado Warning
TOR.description: A tornado has been sighted or indicated by weather radar.
TOR.safety_instructions: Move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a sturdy building. Avoid windows. If in a mobile home, evacuate immediately.

SVR.name: Severe Thunderstorm Warning
SVR.description: Severe thunderstorms are expected with damaging winds, large hail, and/or tornadoes.
SVR.safety_instructions: Take shelter in a sturdy building. Stay away from windows. If outdoors, move away from trees and metal objects.

FFW.name: Flash Flood Warning
FFW.description: Flooding is imminent or already occurring in specified areas.
FFW.safety_instructions: Move to higher ground immediately. Do not attempt to cross flooded roads or streams. Turn around - don't drown.

WSW.name: Winter Storm Warning
WSW.description: Heavy snow, ice, or blizzard conditions are expected.
WSW.safety_instructions: Avoid travel. If travel is necessary, use extreme caution and keep emergency supplies in vehicle.

EWW.name: Extreme Wind Warning
EWW.description: Extreme winds capable of producing significant damage are occurring or imminent.
EWW.safety_instructions: Secure loose objects. Stay indoors and away from windows. Be prepared for widespread power outages.

EXT.name: Extreme Temperature Warning
EXT.description: Dangerously hot or cold temperatures are expected.
EXT.safety_instructions: Limit outdoor exposure. Drink plenty of water. Check on vulnerable individuals. Use air conditioning or heating as needed.
